metaTitle: Mercedes-Benz Failed Engine Rebuild Remediation | Mercedes Garage
metaDescription: Specialist assessment and correction for poorly rebuilt Mercedes-Benz engines. Full strip-down, measurement, re-machining and factory-spec reassembly.
lede: Full assessment, strip-down, and factory-spec correction for engines that were previously rebuilt elsewhere but aren't performing as they should.

blocks.html: When an engine arrives that was previously rebuilt by another workshop, we don't assume anything is correct. We carry out a complete, methodical assessment to determine what was done incorrectly and what can be salvaged, then rebuild the engine to full Mercedes-Benz factory specification.

items: **Visual inspection & strip-down** – we remove the engine and fully disassemble it, recording every detail of the previous work.
**Full component measurement** – all critical dimensions (bearing clearances, cylinder bore, crankshaft journals, valve guides) are measured against original specifications.
**Salvage vs. replace decision** – we identify which parts are still serviceable, which can be re-machined, and which must be replaced.
**Corrective machining & parts sourcing** – we carry out any necessary machining (honing, boring, grinding) and source genuine or OEM-quality replacement parts.
**Factory-spec reassembly** – every bolt is torqued to the correct angle and setting, with all single-use seals and gaskets replaced.
**Final testing and validation** – once reassembled, the engine is tested on the vehicle to confirm oil pressure, temperature stability, and smooth running.

blocks.html: This is not a quick “patch-up” – it is a complete re-engineering of the engine to ensure it meets the durability and performance standards it was designed for.

paras: Additional parts identified during the strip-down are quoted separately. [Pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer)

sections.heading: Our remediation process step by step

steps.title: Arrival & initial inspection
steps.body: We receive the vehicle, note any visible issues, and prepare for engine removal.

steps.title: Full strip-down
steps.body: Engine is removed from the vehicle and completely disassembled on our workbench.

steps.title: Clean & measure every component
steps.body: All parts are cleaned, then inspected with precision gauges to identify out-of-spec items.

steps.title: Salvage assessment & machining
steps.body: We decide what can be re-used, what can be re-machined, and what must be replaced.

steps.title: Factory-spec reassembly
steps.body: Rebuild with new seals, bearings, and correctly torqued fasteners throughout.

steps.title: Vehicle testing & handover
steps.body: Engine fitted back in the vehicle, fully tested, and ready for collection.

items: **Established 2009** – we've been working exclusively on Mercedes-Benz engines for over a decade. [Learn about us](/about).

**Transparent assessment** – you receive a detailed report with photos and a clear breakdown of salvageable parts vs. replacements.
**Fully equipped machine shop** – we carry out all critical machining in-house, reducing lead times and ensuring quality control.
**12-month unlimited-mileage warranty** – our remediation work carries the same warranty as our standard rebuilds.

items.q: How long does a remediation assessment take?
items.a: Removing, stripping and measuring the engine typically takes 1–3 working days. We'll provide a full report and quote once the assessment is complete.

items.q: Can you salvage parts from a failed rebuild?
items.a: Yes – our assessment identifies which components are still within factory specification and can be re-used, and which require machining or replacement.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on remediation work?
items.a: Absolutely. Our remediation rebuild carries the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty as our standard engine rebuilds.

items.q: What types of Mercedes engines do you work on?
items.a: All of them – from 4-cylinder diesel and petrol units to V6, V8, V12 and AMG performance engines. We have full data for every Mercedes engine family in the current range.

items.q: Do you recover vehicles that aren't drivable?
items.a: Yes – we offer nationwide recovery for any Mercedes-Benz. You can [book recovery separately here](/mercedes-engine-recovery).
